title: English Practice Quiz 0678
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Please ___ the details.
questions.explanation: Confirm means to check or establish that something is correct.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.

questions.question: He asked, 'Where do you live?'
options: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I lived.
He asked where I live do.
questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order; do is removed.

questions.question: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Start with a capital letter and use a question mark.
